title: Adverbs of manner (quick → quickly)
en:
Adjectives describe nouns: a careful auditor. Adverbs describe verbs — how we do something: She checks the figures carefully.

Usually adjective + -ly: quick → quickly, clear → clearly, easy → easily, careful → carefully.

Irregular: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard, late → late, early → early. Careful: hardly = almost not; lately = recently.

After be, look, feel, seem, sound use an adjective: You look tired. That sounds good.

Position: usually after the verb + object: She speaks English well (not speaks well English).
ru: Прилагательное — к существительному (a careful auditor), наречие — к глаголу (checks carefully). Обычно + -ly. Исключения: good → well, fast, hard, late, early. hardly = почти не. После be, look, feel, seem — прилагательное (You look tired). Наречие после дополнения: speaks English well.

boss.situation: Describe how three colleagues work, using adverbs (carefully, quickly, well, hard…) and one sentence with look / sound + adjective.
samples: Daniyar works very hard and often stays late.
Marat speaks English well because he studied in London.
The new plan sounds good, but it looks difficult.

qs.exp: hard = with a lot of effort; hardly = almost not.
